author: Andersonqwzx
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised in a supply chain attack. Malicious PyPI packages and Docker images delivered a credential stealer and backdoor. The malware runs at Python startup, targeting cloud credentials, private keys, and AI tool credentials.

author: dangsoun
text: Bitcoin devs rush to patch 3 security flaws found by AI. Bitcoin Core has disclosed three security vulnerabilities discovered through AI scanning, including two that could allow malicious peers to exhaust node memory and crash systems. Disclosed Oct. 28.

text: Coinspect researchers discovered CVE-2026-118668, a LangGraph authorization flaw that could allow one agent to read and modify another agent's stored data.

author: Magnexis
text: Security researchers have uncovered a campaign compromising 42 GitHub repositories using malicious payloads designed to evade conventional code searches, targeting developers using GitHub and AI coding agents. Some payloads were hidden in files as large as 13.7 MB.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: A personal Claude Code account ran on a secure Pentagon network for two months and appears to have sent the contractor's login credentials to a third-party site NIST calls high-risk (per WIRED's investigative account).

author: dailytechonx
text: A North Korea-aligned group now steals Git credentials and injects malware via npm, PyPI packages and GitHub, and uses blockchain tricks to avoid takedowns. Secure your tools, rotate keys, and audit dependencies.

author: noelkimx
text: A function name the model picks is untrusted input. Agno's PandasTools passed it to getattr, so a prompt injection could make the agent call read_pickle on an attacker's file and run code (CVE-2026-119050). I'd grep my tools for getattr on those names and allowlist each hit.

author: fireball_triada
text: A malicious MCP server can run PowerShell on your PC during OAuth sign-in. OpenCode 1.0.137-1.18.32 on Windows/WSL passed the server's auth URL to open@10.x, so $(...) executes. Root cause: CVE-2026-119025.

text:

Up to 5,000 users installed it.

author: Basant_Pandey
text:
Agent bug worth a look: @agno_agi PandasTools (through 3.1.11) passes a model-chosen function name to getattr(). Prompt injection can make it call read_pickle on an attacker path, which is code execution. CVE-2026-119050, 9.2.

Lesson I keep relearning: tools need allowlists.
